name: Scroll Reveal
summary: Elements fade in and rise as they enter the viewport, driven by CSS alone — no scroll listener, no library.
summaryZh: 元素进入视口时淡入并上移，纯 CSS 驱动，不挂滚动监听。

name: Magnetic Button
summary: A button that leans toward the cursor as it approaches, then springs back when you leave. Under 20 lines of JavaScript.
summaryZh: 光标靠近时按钮朝光标方向偏移，离开后回弹。不到 20 行 JS。

name: Text Mask Reveal
summary: An oversized headline slides up from behind a hard edge, line by line, with a staggered delay.
summaryZh: 大标题逐行从硬遮罩后方向上滑出，带错峰延迟。

name: Sticky Scroll Story
summary: A panel stays pinned while the copy advances beside it — the standard structure for brand storytelling.
summaryZh: 面板固定不动，旁边文案逐步推进——品牌叙事页的标准结构。

name: Aurora Background
summary: Soft blurred colour fields drift behind the content, slow enough to read as atmosphere rather than motion.
summaryZh: 柔和的模糊色块在内容后方缓慢漂移，慢到只被感知为氛围而非动效。

name: Card Spotlight
summary: A soft highlight tracks the pointer across a card surface, revealing a border glow at the same position.
summaryZh: 柔和高光跟随指针划过卡片表面，同位置同时点亮边框光。
